    The finite-string embedding functor #

    For a literal string word C, Butler--Ringel's functor S_C replaces every one-dimensional position of the literal string module by a copy of a supplied vector space. Concretely, its value at a quiver vertex x is

    C.Space x ⊗ V,

    and an arrow acts by the literal string arrow map tensored with the identity of V. Defining this after the string representation has descended through the relation quotient makes the relation check automatic.
